basis: PMID 32086342 / PMC7299809 (Clin Cancer Res 2020, doi 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-19-2706), Results: 'We generated a tissue microarray (TMA) of 32 patient-matched NF/PNF and MPNST pairs that included 3 ANNUBPs from 12 NF1 patients cared for at the Iowa NF Clinic'; Methods: '12 paired neurofibromas and MPNSTs ..., 1 unpaired neurofibroma and 2 unpaired MPNSTs' from University of Iowa Pathology under IRB 201507708; the RNA-seq used FFPE cores adjacent to those TMA cores.
caveat: Cohort-level statement only: clinical NF1 diagnosis at an NF clinic, not per-patient germline sequencing ('germline' does not appear in the paper). The paper ties '12 NF1 patients' to the paired TMA cohort while GEO carries 15 distinct patient ids; the retrieved text does not reconcile the two, so confidence stays medium and the patient mapping is still open.

basis: PMID 34040258 Extended Data Table 1: the RNA-seq non-neoplastic brain group is NOP454N plus DIPG46N/DIPG51N/DIPG48N/DIPG70N, the latter four being frontal cortex from DIPG patients; NOP454N pairs by id with NF1-PA sample NOP454. Methods: samples came from paediatric tumour banks at St. Louis Children's Hospital, UCLA and Stanford.
caveat: Needs a sixth value in the control taxonomy: 'control_nonneoplastic_other_disease' for non-neoplastic tissue from patients with an unrelated tumour. Paediatric 'normal brain' in GEO is nearly always of this kind, so the gap will recur beyond this dataset.

basis: Kara's ruling 2026-10-05 removes the sporadic PAs and PA_33; the surviving controls are CTL_1 to CTL_7, all nf1=CTL with tumor=CTL. PA_33 was the eighth such sample and is removed as ambiguous; CTL_11, the ninth in the stored count, is self-inconsistent and held out as unresolved.
caveat: CTL_11 excluded per Kara 2026-10-05, so the count is final at 7: CTL_1 to CTL_7.

basis: 13 NF1-associated PA cases plus 7 non-neoplastic brain controls after removing 18 sporadic PA (including the misleadingly titled CTL_8/9/10), 4 glioblastoma comparators and the ambiguous PA_33, per Kara's ruling 2026-10-05. Sample-level detail in phase-2/data/phase2-sample-overrides.csv.
caveat: Final: PA_33 and CTL_11 both excluded as ambiguous.

basis: The 10 Lats1;2 samples are not NF-genotype models: PMID 34647023 states Hippo pathway mutations are rarely found in MPNST and reports Lats-driven tumours as transcriptomically distinct from Nf1;p53-driven tumours, clustering with GEM-neurofibroma and human PNF/NF. The NF-genotype samples are the 12 Nf1;Trp53 mouse tumours (9 NP-Plp, 3 NPcis).
caveat: Applies to the deferred mouse track. For the human-only first pass the dataset contributes 0 samples, since all 22 human samples lack any stated NF1 status.

basis: There is no sporadic-versus-NF split in the human arm to justify 'mixed': the human samples carry no NF1 status at all. The NF content of the series is the engineered Nf1;Trp53 mouse arm.
caveat: Proposed; the NP-Plp arm itself mimics both sporadic and NF1-associated genetics, not separable in GEO.

basis: All 40 array samples are immunoprecipitations (20 HuR IP, 20 IgG IP) with no total-RNA or input arm, the 6 RNA-seq samples are a shHuR-versus-shControl knockdown in ST88-14, and the remaining 40 are ChIP-seq. There is no tumour-versus-tumour abundance comparison in the series.
caveat: Drops the series from the comparative set: 49 -> 48, human launch set 29 -> 28.

basis: The stored count of 23 control_isogenic_engineered labels matches no set of samples in the series: there are 20 IgG immunoprecipitation samples, all in the RIP/array arm (6 NF1-derived MPNST, 6 sporadic MPNST, 4 dermal neurofibroma, 4 plexiform neurofibroma), and the ChIP arm carries 6 inputs and no IgG antibody at all. Both kinds are assay controls, not a biological control arm, and no isogenic or engineered line appears anywhere in the 86 samples.
caveat: This was the defect the Phase 1a audit flagged. The audit's own wording, and an earlier version of this row, described the 23 as IgG controls; the sample list shows 20 IgG and no IgG in the ChIP arm, so the 23 is a labelling artefact.

basis: Of the 50 samples, 33 are human (31 RNA-seq, 2 ATAC-seq) and 17 mouse (14 Lats1/2-deficient, 1 Nf1-mut, 2 NPE-mut). Only the 31 human RNA-seq samples enter the human pass.
caveat: The 3 Nf1-genotype mouse samples stay in the logs for the mouse pass; the 14 Lats1/2 samples are excluded as a non-NF comparator model.

basis: Wu et al. (PMID 36322658) describe the cohort as 'NF1-mutated PNF' and 'NF1-associated MPNST' but give no per-sample NF1 genotype for the named samples.
caveat: Confidence stays medium on this basis.

basis: Table S1 of the primary publication (Genome Medicine 2025, PMC11992879, Additional file 1) assigns each of the 22 patients a tumour predisposition syndrome: 11 NF2-related schwannomatosis, 5 non-NF2-related schwannomatosis, 6 with none recorded. Sample titles carry the patient id, so all 151 plates map to a patient.
caveat: 104 plates from the 16 syndromic patients; the remaining 47 come from 6 patients recorded as sporadic, radiation-associated or with no predisposition data.

basis: Same source as the in-scope count.
Per-patient predisposition and clinical genetics are tabulated in Table S1; sample ids resolve to patients.
The in-scope patients split 11 NF2-related schwannomatosis and 5 non-NF2-related schwannomatosis (one with a germline t(5;19) translocation, two recorded simply as schwannomatosis).

The NF2-associated vs sporadic subtype annotation exists only on the 45 Illumina 450K methylation samples (GPL13534). The 44 expression arrays (GPL10739) carry no genotype field and their titles (S_1..S_31, N_*, NonV1-4) do not bridge to the methylation titles.
caveat: Revisit if the publication (PMID 25533176, closed access) or a corrected GEO submission maps the expression sample ids.

basis: Same source: the 6 NF2-associated samples are methylation arrays.
The 14 control-annotated samples split 9 expression / 5 methylation, and the expression controls cannot be paired with genotyped tumours.

The genotype field names 6 sgNf1 samples (Nf1_p53_1..5 and Nf1_p53_5_CL2D); every other sample is a non-Nf1 EPO-GEMM model (SS18-SSX1, KRASG12V, ETV6-NTRK3, PAX3-FOXO1, sgSmarcb1, sgp53, WT) or untyped.
caveat: Applies to the deferred mouse track. The stored n_control_samples=12 is not reproducible from the genotype field (WT=6); re-derive it in the mouse pass.

basis: Same source.
Nf1 loss is engineered somatically by muscle electroporation (EPO-GEMM CRISPR), not germline; there is no sporadic human arm.
All arms are engineered hGFAP-cre mouse lines; the p53-only arm is an isogenic comparator, not sporadic material.
caveat: Deferred mouse track. Biallelic Nf1 loss in the tumours is asserted by breeding design only - the paper reports no LOH, sequencing or IHC confirmation.
